sources.what: LIBERO-CF (the benchmark: a fork of LIBERO with the CF suites, their conditions and the OR termination)

build: git clone https://github.com/yuffish/LIBERO-CF && git -C LIBERO-CF checkout 8280a500a01f7f7d45efe202cb416ca362aa8c1a

uv pip sync requirements.txt requirements_libero.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu113 --index-strategy=unsafe-best-match   (the release's own pins: robosuite 1.4.1, mujoco 3.2.3, numpy 1.22.4, torch 1.11.0, imageio 2.35.1, imageio-ffmpeg 0.5.1)
notes: The release's own commands (README, 'Installation'); openpi-client is not needed: the evaluation is this repository's.
The release's evaluator renders with SegmentationRenderEnv when it imports (eval/main_cf.py L460-466) and with OffScreenRenderEnv otherwise; which the loader uses is the loader's and is recorded.
check: python -c "from libero.libero import benchmark; d = benchmark.get_benchmark_dict(); print([d[s]().n_tasks for s in ('libero_cf_spatial', 'libero_cf_object', 'libero_cf_ood')])"   (expected [15, 10, 15])
